data.name: Dew
data.gender_notes: Dew is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Inspired by the gentle, nurturing essence of morning dew. Often symbolizing renewal and rebirth in nature and spiritual traditions. The name Dew carries the meaning “Tiny drops of water” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dew usually hope their child will grow to embody tiny drops of water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's grace and presence in the smallest details of life.
data.etymology: Dew belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tiny drops of water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dew total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: טל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם 'טל' מקורו במילה העברית 'טל', שפירושה טל הבוקר, לחלוחיות שיורדות מן השמיים על האדמה. הוא סמלי לחידוש, לרעננות ולברכה. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם 'טל' יכול לייצג את הטל הרוחני, שפירושו ברכה והשראה אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Δ露
in_greek.meaning: Δ露 σημαίνει ανανέωση και πνευματική χάρη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα 'Δ露' προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για τη δροσιά, που συμβολίζει την ανανέωση, τη φρεσκάδα και τη χάρη. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, η δροσιά ήταν σύμβολο της πνευματικής χάρης και της ανανέωσης που έρχεται από τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Dew
in_latin.meaning: Dew significat mane stillans et spiritualis gratia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Dew' a Latina voce 'dew' derivatur, quae mane stillans seu ros indicat. In traditione Christiana, 'Dew' est symbolum gratiae spiritualis, renovationis et inspirationis divinae, quae corda hominum illustrat.

in_english.name: Dew
in_english.meaning: Dew represents spiritual refreshment and divine blessing
in_english.long_meaning: The name 'Dew' originates from the Hebrew word 'טל' (Tal), meaning 'dew'. It symbolizes spiritual refreshment, divine blessing, and renewal. In the Bible, dew is often associated with God's blessings and mercy. Throughout Christian tradition, 'Dew' has been used to signify the refreshing presence of God and the hope of spiritual rejuvenation.

data.cultural_impact: In Indonesia, the word "Dewa" means 'god' or 'deity' in their Indonesian language.
data.spiritual_significance: Dew as a name can also represent a connection to the divine or a reminder of the spiritual nature of all things.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Dew remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Dew in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Dew, which means "Tiny drops of water". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
